prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Strontium (스트론튬) itself — the sovereign of the Strontium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cheerful, sunny openness; warm beige skin; oval face; large eyes — soft droopy eyes, level outer eye corners; soft rounded brows; upturned nose; full heart-shaped lips; teal eyes; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Body and hair: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs build; a shaggy layered wolf cut with choppy uneven bangs; crimson-red hair whose tips keep a soft aqua-green afterglow in shadow.
Expression: a light teasing smile, bright eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: strontium: a soft silvery alkaline-earth metal that yellows in air, named for Strontian, a village in the Scottish Highlands whose lead mines yielded the strange stone strontianite around 1790, its metal freed by electricity in 1808; its salts burn the deepest crimson red of any flame, the red of fireworks and of distress flares at sea; strontium aluminate glow paint drinks in light and gives it back as a soft aqua-green afterglow for hours in the dark; like calcium it settles into bones and seashells.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Minimal thin warm-grey armor with large thrusters at the calves and ankles, every plate edge traced with soft aqua-green afterglow lines, slim crimson flare launch tubes at the hips, a small heather-purple core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: minimal thin armor with large thrusters at the calves and ankles — a light, fast, forward-leaning silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: deep crimson flare red, soft aqua-green afterglow, heather purple, warm stone grey.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city that stores daylight: streets, stairways and towers paved with afterglow stone that drinks in the sun all day and gives it back as a soft aqua-green glow all night, glowing guide lines that still trace every path in a blackout, a rescue base launching crimson signal flares.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Sr) and atomic number (38) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
